name: @pyreon/example-native-showcase-web
description: PRIVATE / EXPERIMENTAL — the Today showcase on the web: ../native-showcase/src/TodayApp.tsx rendered to HTML at build time and hydrated in the browser. The same file compiles to SwiftUI (native-showcase-ios) and Jetpack Compose (native-showcase-android).

scripts.build: vite build && vite build --ssr src/entry-server.ts --outDir dist-server && bun scripts/prerender.ts
